sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[api.controller = function() {
    var c = this;

    // ── PAGE IDs (confirmed from your ServiceNow Pages list) ──
    var PAGE_IDS = {
        home: 'test_catalog', // ← CORRECT page ID from your screenshot
        labReports: 'lab_reports'
    };

    c.loading = true;
    c.activeTab = 'all';
    c.searchQuery = '';
    c.sortBy = 'date_desc';
    c.filteredAppointments = [];
    c.showModal = false;
    c.selectedAppt = null;

    c.tabs = [{
            key: 'all',
            label: 'All',
            count: 0
        },
        {
            key: 'pending',
            label: 'Pending',
            count: 0
        },
        {
            key: 'confirmed',
            label: 'Confirmed',
            count: 0
        },
        {
            key: 'completed',
            label: 'Completed',
            count: 0
        },
        {
            key: 'cancelled',
            label: 'Cancelled',
            count: 0
        }
    ];

    c.stats = [{
            icon: ']]>📋<![CDATA[',
            label: 'Total',
            count: 0
        },
        {
            icon: '✅',
            label: 'Confirmed',
            count: 0
        },
        {
            icon: '⏳',
            label: 'Pending',
            count: 0
        },
        {
            icon: '✔️',
            label: 'Completed',
            count: 0
        }
    ];

    // ── NAVIGATION ────────────────────────────────────────────
    var _nav = function(pageId) {
        var portalId = window.location.pathname.split('/')[1] || 'sp';
        window.location.href = '/' + portalId + '?id=' + pageId;
    };

    // ── INIT ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // KEY FIX: ServiceNow populates c.data synchronously BEFORE this runs.
    // $watch('data') never fires. Just read data directly in $onInit.
    c.$onInit = function() {
        c.loading = false;
        c.buildStats();
        c.filterAppointments();
    };

    c.buildStats = function() {
        var appts = c.data.appointments || [];
        c.stats[0].count = appts.length;
        c.stats[1].count = appts.filter(function(a) {
            return a.status === 'confirmed';
        }).length;
        c.stats[2].count = appts.filter(function(a) {
            return a.status === 'pending';
        }).length;
        c.stats[3].count = appts.filter(function(a) {
            return a.status === 'completed';
        }).length;
        c.tabs.forEach(function(tab) {
            tab.count = (tab.key === 'all') ?
                appts.length :
                appts.filter(function(a) {
                    return a.status === tab.key;
                }).length;
        });
    };

    c.setTab = function(key) {
        c.activeTab = key;
        c.filterAppointments();
    };

    c.filterAppointments = function() {
        var appts = angular.copy(c.data.appointments || []);
        var q = (c.searchQuery || '').toLowerCase();
        var tab = c.activeTab;
        c.filteredAppointments = appts.filter(function(a) {
            var matchTab = (tab === 'all') || (a.status === tab);
            var matchSearch = !q ||
                (a.test_name && a.test_name.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1) ||
                (a.appointment_number && a.appointment_number.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1) ||
                (a.test_category && a.test_category.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1);
            return matchTab && matchSearch;
        });
        c.sortAppointments();
    };

    c.sortAppointments = function() {
        c.filteredAppointments.sort(function(a, b) {
            if (c.sortBy === 'date_asc') return (a.scheduled_date || '').localeCompare(b.scheduled_date || '');
            if (c.sortBy === 'date_desc') return (b.scheduled_date || '').localeCompare(a.scheduled_date || '');
            if (c.sortBy === 'status') return (a.status || '').localeCompare(b.status || '');
            return 0;
        });
    };

    // ── STATUS HELPERS ────────────────────────────────────────
    var STATUS_MAP = {
        'pending': {
            color: '#f59e0b',
            bg: '#fef3c7',
            icon: '⏳',
            label: 'Pending'
        },
        'confirmed': {
            color: '#3b82f6',
            bg: '#dbeafe',
            icon: '✅',
            label: 'Confirmed'
        },
        'completed': {
            color: '#10b981',
            bg: '#dcfce7',
            icon: '✔️',
            label: 'Completed'
        },
        'cancelled': {
            color: '#6b7280',
            bg: '#f1f5f9',
            icon: ']]>🚫<![CDATA[',
            label: 'Cancelled'
        },
        'rejected': {
            color: '#ef4444',
            bg: '#fee2e2',
            icon: '❌',
            label: 'Rejected'
        }
    };
    var _statusProp = function(s, prop, fallback) {
        return (STATUS_MAP[s] && STATUS_MAP[s][prop]) ? STATUS_MAP[s][prop] : fallback;
    };
    c.getStatusColor = function(s) {
        return _statusProp(s, 'color', '#94a3b8');
    };
    c.getStatusBg = function(s) {
        return _statusProp(s, 'bg', '#f1f5f9');
    };
    c.getStatusIcon = function(s) {
        return _statusProp(s, 'icon', '•');
    };
    c.getStatusLabel = function(s) {
        return _statusProp(s, 'label', s);
    };

    c.getApprovalLabel = function(s) {
        var m = {
            'requested': 'Approval Requested',
            'approved': '✅ Approved',
            'rejected': '❌ Rejected'
        };
        return m[s] || s;
    };
    c.getPaymentLabel = function(s) {
        var m = {
            'paid': '✓ Paid',
            'pending': 'Payment Pending',
            'unpaid': 'Unpaid',
            'refunded': 'Refunded'
        };
        return m[s] || (s || 'N/A');
    };
    c.getCategoryIcon = function(cat) {
        var icons = {
            'blood': ']]>🩸<![CDATA[',
            'urine': ']]>🧪<![CDATA[',
            'imaging': ']]>🩻<![CDATA[',
            'cardiology': '❤️',
            'neurology': ']]>🧠<![CDATA[',
            'genetics': ']]>🧬<![CDATA[',
            'pathology': ']]>🔬<![CDATA['
        };
        if (!cat) return ']]>🔬<![CDATA[';
        var k = cat.toLowerCase();
        for (var key in icons) {
            if (k.indexOf(key) !== -1) return icons[key];
        }
        return ']]>🔬<![CDATA[';
    };

    c.canCancel = function(appt) {
        return appt.status === 'pending' || appt.status === 'confirmed';
    };

    // CANCEL 
    c.cancelAppointment = function(appt) {
        if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to cancel appointment ' + appt.appointment_number + '?')) return;
        c.server.get({
                action: 'cancel_appointment',
                appointment_sys_id: appt.sys_id
            })
            .then(function(response) {
                if (response.data.success) {
                    appt.status = 'cancelled';
                    c.buildStats();
                    c.filterAppointments();
                    alert('Appointment cancelled successfully.');
                } else {
                    alert('Error: ' + (response.data.error || 'Failed to cancel.'));
                }
            });
    };

    // ── MODAL ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    c.viewDetails = function(appt) {
        c.selectedAppt = appt;
        c.showModal = true;
    };
    c.closeModal = function() {
        c.showModal = false;
        c.selectedAppt = null;
    };

    // ── NAVIGATION ────────────────────────────────────────────
    // KEY FIX: "Book New Test" now goes to correct page ID "test_catalog"
    c.bookNew = function() {
        _nav(PAGE_IDS.home);
    };
    c.viewReport = function(appt) {
        _nav(PAGE_IDS.labReports);
    };
}]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>.my-appts {
  --primary: #0a2463;
  --accent: #00b4d8;
  --success: #10b981;
  --warning: #f59e0b;
  --danger: #ef4444;
  --info: #3b82f6;
  --gray-50: #f8fafc;
  --gray-100: #f1f5f9;
  --gray-200: #e2e8f0;
  --gray-400: #94a3b8;
  --gray-600: #475569;
  --gray-800: #1e293b;
  --white: #ffffff;
  --shadow-sm: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.07);
  --shadow-md: 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.09);
  --radius: 14px;
  font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif;
  background: var(--gray-50);
  min-height: 100vh;
  padding: 0 0 60px;
}

/* ---------- HEADER ---------- */
.appts-header {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary) 0%, #1e3a8a 100%);
  padding: 40px 40px 50px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  border-radius: 0 0 32px 32px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 20px;
}

.header-title {
  font-size: 32px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--white);
  margin: 0 0 8px;
}

.header-sub { color: #bfdbfe; margin: 0; font-size: 15px; }

.btn-book-new {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 12px 24px;
  background: var(--accent);
  color: var(--white);
  border: none;
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0,180,216,0.35);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.btn-book-new:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0,180,216,0.45); }

/* ---------- STATS BAR ---------- */
.stats-bar {
  display: flex;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 24px 40px 0;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.stat-card {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 120px;
  background: var(--white);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
  padding: 16px 20px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition: box-shadow 0.2s;
}

.stat-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }

.stat-icon { font-size: 28px; }
.stat-info { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.stat-val { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--primary); line-height: 1; }
.stat-name { font-size: 12px; color: var(--gray-600); font-weight: 500; margin-top: 2px; }

/* ---------- FILTER TABS ---------- */
.filter-tabs {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 24px 40px 0;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.filter-tab {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 8px 18px;
  border-radius: 24px;
  border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
  background: var(--white);
  color: var(--gray-600);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s;
}

.filter-tab:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }

.filter-tab.active {
  background: var(--primary);
  border-color: var(--primary);
  color: var(--white);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(10,36,99,0.25);
}

.tab-count {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 1px 7px;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.filter-tab:not(.active) .tab-count {
  background: var(--gray-100);
  color: var(--gray-600);
}

/* ---------- LIST CONTROLS ---------- */
.list-controls {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 16px 40px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.search-mini-wrap {
  position: relative;
  flex: 1;
  max-width: 320px;
}

.search-mini-wrap .fa {
  position: absolute;
  left: 12px;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  color: var(--gray-400);
}

.search-mini {
  padding: 9px 14px 9px 36px;
  border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 14px;
  width: 100%;
  outline: none;
  transition: border-color 0.2s;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.search-mini:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }

.sort-mini {
  padding: 9px 14px;
  border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 14px;
  background: var(--white);
  cursor: pointer;
  outline: none;
}

.sort-mini:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }

/* ---------- LOADING ---------- */
.loading-center { text-align: center; padding: 60px; color: var(--gray-600); }
.spinner-ring {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 44px; height: 44px;
  border: 4px solid var(--gray-200);
  border-top-color: var(--accent);
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}
@keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

/* ---------- EMPTY STATE ---------- */
.empty-appts { text-align: center; padding: 60px 40px; }
.empty-emoji { font-size: 56px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.empty-appts h3 { font-size: 20px; color: var(--gray-800); margin: 0 0 8px; }
.empty-appts p { color: var(--gray-600); margin: 0 0 20px; }

.btn-book-first {
  padding: 12px 28px;
  background: var(--primary);
  color: var(--white);
  border: none;
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.2s;
}

.btn-book-first:hover { background: #1e3a8a; }

/* ---------- APPOINTMENTS LIST ---------- */
.appts-list {
  padding: 8px 40px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
}

/* ---------- APPOINTMENT CARD ---------- */
.appt-card {
  background: var(--white);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
  display: flex;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
}

.appt-card:hover {
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.appt-accent-bar { width: 5px; flex-shrink: 0; }

.appt-content { flex: 1; padding: 20px 24px; }

/* TOP ROW */
.appt-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  gap: 12px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.appt-title-group { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; }
.appt-icon { font-size: 32px; }

.appt-test-name {
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--gray-800);
  margin: 0 0 4px;
}

.appt-number { font-size: 12px; color: var(--gray-400); font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; }

.appt-status-wrap { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }

/* STATUS PILLS */
.status-pill {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  padding: 5px 14px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: capitalize;
}

.approval-pill {
  padding: 4px 12px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: capitalize;
}

.approval-requested { background: #fef3c7; color: #92400e; }
.approval-approved { background: #dcfce7; color: #166534; }
.approval-rejected { background: #fee2e2; color: #991b1b; }

/* META ROW */
.appt-meta {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.meta-chip {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--gray-600);
  background: var(--gray-100);
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border-radius: 6px;
}

.meta-chip .fa { color: var(--accent); font-size: 12px; }

/* INFO ROW */
.appt-info-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.info-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  font-size: 12px;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.pay-paid { background: #dcfce7; color: #166534; }
.pay-pending { background: #fef3c7; color: #92400e; }
.pay-unpaid { background: #fee2e2; color: #991b1b; }
.approval-info { background: #dbeafe; color: #1d4ed8; }
.conf-badge { background: #f0fdf4; color: #166534; }

/* NOTES */
.appt-notes {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--gray-600);
  background: var(--gray-50);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--gray-200);
  padding: 6px 12px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0;
  font-style: italic;
}

/* REJECTION BANNER */
.rejection-banner {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 10px;
  background: #fef2f2;
  border: 1px solid #fecaca;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #991b1b;
}

/* ACTIONS */
.appt-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.appt-action-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 7px 16px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  border: none;
  transition: all 0.2s;
}

.btn-view { background: #dbeafe; color: #1d4ed8; }
.btn-view:hover { background: #bfdbfe; }

.btn-cancel { background: #fee2e2; color: #b91c1c; }
.btn-cancel:hover { background: #fecaca; }

.btn-report { background: #dcfce7; color: #166534; }
.btn-report:hover { background: #bbf7d0; }

.date-chip {
  margin-left: auto;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--gray-400);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* ---------- MODAL ---------- */
.modal-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  z-index: 9999;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 20px;
}

.modal-box {
  background: var(--white);
  border-radius: 20px;
  max-width: 560px;
  width: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
  animation: slideUp 0.3s ease;
}

@keyframes slideUp {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

.modal-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 20px 24px;
  background: var(--primary);
  color: var(--white);
}

.modal-header h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; }

.modal-close {
  background: none;
  border: none;
  color: var(--white);
  font-size: 20px;
  cursor: pointer;
  line-height: 1;
  opacity: 0.8;
  transition: opacity 0.2s;
}

.modal-close:hover { opacity: 1; }

.modal-body { padding: 24px; }

.detail-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 14px;
}

.detail-item {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
}

.detail-item.full { grid-column: 1 / -1; }

.detail-key { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gray-400); letter-spacing: 0.4px; }
.detail-val { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--gray-800); }
.detail-val.mono { font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; color: var(--primary); }
.detail-val.paid-green { color: var(--success); font-size: 16px; }

.modal-footer {
  padding: 16px 24px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-end;
}

.btn-close-modal {
  padding: 10px 24px;
  background: var(--primary);
  color: var(--white);
  border: none;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.2s;
}

.btn-close-modal:hover { background: #1e3a8a; }

/* ---------- RESPONSIVE ---------- */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .appts-header, .stats-bar, .filter-tabs, .list-controls, .appts-list {
    padding-left: 16px; padding-right: 16px;
  }
  .stats-bar { gap: 10px; }
  .stat-card { min-width: 100px; }
  .appt-top { flex-direction: column; }
  .date-chip { margin-left: 0; }
  .detail-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}</css><data_table>sp_instance</data_table><demo_data/><description>Widget to display and manage functionalities</description><docs/><field_list/><has_preview>false</has_preview><id>my_appointments</id><internal>false</internal><link><![CDATA[function link(scope, element, attrs, controller) {
  
}]]></link><name>My Appointments</name><option_schema/><public>true</public><roles/><script><![CDATA[(function() {

    // ============================================================
    // MEDICARE - MY APPOINTMENTS
    // Application Scope: x_2056490_medica_0
    // ============================================================

    data.appointments = [];
    data.success = false;
    data.error = '';

    // ============================================================
    // EXACT TABLE NAMES
    // ============================================================

    var PATIENT_TABLE =
        'x_2056490_medica_0_patient_table';

    var APPOINTMENT_TABLE =
        'x_2056490_medica_0_appointment_table';

    var DIAGNOSTIC_TEST_TABLE =
        'x_2056490_medica_0_diagnostic_test_table';

    var REPORT_TABLE =
        'x_2056490_medica_0_report_table';


    // ============================================================
    // CHECK TABLES
    // ============================================================

    try {

        var patientCheck =
            new GlideRecord(PATIENT_TABLE);

        if (!patientCheck.isValid()) {
            data.error = 'Patient table is invalid: ' + PATIENT_TABLE;
            gs.error(data.error);
            return;
        }


        var appointmentCheck =
            new GlideRecord(APPOINTMENT_TABLE);

        if (!appointmentCheck.isValid()) {
            data.error = 'Appointment table is invalid: ' + APPOINTMENT_TABLE;
            gs.error(data.error);
            return;
        }


        var testCheck =
            new GlideRecord(DIAGNOSTIC_TEST_TABLE);

        if (!testCheck.isValid()) {
            data.error = 'Diagnostic Test table is invalid: ' +
                         DIAGNOSTIC_TEST_TABLE;
            gs.error(data.error);
            return;
        }


        var reportCheck =
            new GlideRecord(REPORT_TABLE);

        if (!reportCheck.isValid()) {
            data.error = 'Report table is invalid: ' + REPORT_TABLE;
            gs.error(data.error);
            return;
        }

    } catch (tableError) {

        data.error =
            'Table validation error: ' + tableError.message;

        gs.error(
            'MediCare Table Validation Error: ' +
            tableError.message
        );

        return;
    }


    // ============================================================
    // CURRENT USER
    // ============================================================

    var currentUser = gs.getUser();

    var userID =
        gs.getUserID() || '';

    var userEmail =
        currentUser.getEmail() || '';

    var userName =
        gs.getUserName() || '';


    gs.info(
        'MediCare My Appointments - User: ' +
        userName +
        ' | User ID: ' +
        userID
    );


    // ============================================================
    // FIND PATIENT RECORDS
    // ============================================================

    var patientSysIds = [];
    var patientMap = {};


    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // A. PATIENT LINKED TO CURRENT USER
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    try {

        var patGr =
            new GlideRecord(PATIENT_TABLE);

        if (patGr.isValidField('user')) {

            patGr.addQuery(
                'user',
                userID
            );

            patGr.query();

            while (patGr.next()) {

                var pid =
                    patGr.getUniqueValue();

                if (!patientMap[pid]) {

                    patientMap[pid] = true;
                    patientSysIds.push(pid);
                }
            }
        }

    } catch (patientUserError) {

        gs.warn(
            'MediCare Patient User Query Error: ' +
            patientUserError.message
        );
    }


    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // B. PATIENT MATCHING USER EMAIL
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    if (userEmail) {

        try {

            var patEmailGr =
                new GlideRecord(PATIENT_TABLE);

            if (patEmailGr.isValidField('email')) {

                patEmailGr.addQuery(
                    'email',
                    userEmail
                );

                patEmailGr.query();

                while (patEmailGr.next()) {

                    var emailPatientID =
                        patEmailGr.getUniqueValue();

                    if (!patientMap[emailPatientID]) {

                        patientMap[emailPatientID] = true;
                        patientSysIds.push(emailPatientID);
                    }
                }
            }

        } catch (patientEmailError) {

            gs.warn(
                'MediCare Patient Email Query Error: ' +
                patientEmailError.message
            );
        }
    }


    // ============================================================
    // FIND APPOINTMENTS CREATED BY CURRENT USER
    // ============================================================

    var appointmentSysIds = [];
    var appointmentMap = {};


    try {

        var createdByGr =
            new GlideRecord(APPOINTMENT_TABLE);

        if (createdByGr.isValidField('created_by')) {

            createdByGr.addQuery(
                'created_by',
                userID
            );

            createdByGr.orderByDesc(
                'sys_created_on'
            );

            createdByGr.query();

            while (createdByGr.next()) {

                var appointmentID =
                    createdByGr.getUniqueValue();

                if (!appointmentMap[appointmentID]) {

                    appointmentMap[appointmentID] = true;

                    appointmentSysIds.push(
                        appointmentID
                    );


                    // ------------------------------------------------
                    // Also collect patient from appointment
                    // ------------------------------------------------

                    if (
                        createdByGr.isValidField('patient')
                    ) {

                        var patientRef =
                            createdByGr.getValue('patient');

                        if (
                            patientRef &&
                            !patientMap[patientRef]
                        ) {

                            patientMap[patientRef] = true;

                            patientSysIds.push(
                                patientRef
                            );
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

    } catch (createdByError) {

        gs.warn(
            'MediCare Appointment Created By Error: ' +
            createdByError.message
        );
    }


    // ============================================================
    // FIND APPOINTMENTS LINKED TO PATIENT
    // ============================================================

    if (patientSysIds.length > 0) {

        try {

            var patientAppointmentGr =
                new GlideRecord(APPOINTMENT_TABLE);

            if (
                patientAppointmentGr.isValidField(
                    'patient'
                )
            ) {

                patientAppointmentGr.addQuery(
                    'patient',
                    'IN',
                    patientSysIds.join(',')
                );

                patientAppointmentGr.orderByDesc(
                    'sys_created_on'
                );

                patientAppointmentGr.query();

                while (
                    patientAppointmentGr.next()
                ) {

                    var patientAppointmentID =
                        patientAppointmentGr.getUniqueValue();

                    if (
                        !appointmentMap[
                            patientAppointmentID
                        ]
                    ) {

                        appointmentMap[
                            patientAppointmentID
                        ] = true;

                        appointmentSysIds.push(
                            patientAppointmentID
                        );
                    }
                }
            }

        } catch (patientAppointmentError) {

            gs.warn(
                'MediCare Patient Appointment Error: ' +
                patientAppointmentError.message
            );
        }
    }


    // ============================================================
    // HANDLE CANCEL APPOINTMENT
    // ============================================================

    if (
        input &&
        input.action === 'cancel_appointment'
    ) {

        try {

            var cancelGr =
                new GlideRecord(APPOINTMENT_TABLE);

            if (
                cancelGr.get(
                    input.appointment_sys_id
                )
            ) {

                var isOwner = false;


                // ------------------------------------------------
                // CHECK CREATED BY
                // ------------------------------------------------

                if (
                    cancelGr.isValidField(
                        'created_by'
                    )
                ) {

                    if (
                        cancelGr.getValue(
                            'created_by'
                        ) === userID
                    ) {

                        isOwner = true;
                    }
                }


                // ------------------------------------------------
                // CHECK PATIENT OWNERSHIP
                // ------------------------------------------------

                if (!isOwner) {

                    if (
                        cancelGr.isValidField(
                            'patient'
                        )
                    ) {

                        var cancelPatientID =
                            cancelGr.getValue(
                                'patient'
                            );

                        if (
                            cancelPatientID &&
                            patientMap[
                                cancelPatientID
                            ]
                        ) {

                            isOwner = true;
                        }
                    }
                }


                // ------------------------------------------------
                // CANCEL
                // ------------------------------------------------

                if (isOwner) {

                    if (
                        cancelGr.isValidField(
                            'status'
                        )
                    ) {

                        cancelGr.setValue(
                            'status',
                            'cancelled'
                        );
                    }

                    cancelGr.update();

                    data.success = true;


                    // ------------------------------------------------
                    // CANCELLATION EMAIL
                    // ------------------------------------------------

                    try {

                        var cancellationEmail = '';


                        if (
                            cancelGr.isValidField(
                                'patient'
                            )
                        ) {

                            var cancelPatientRef =
                                cancelGr.getValue(
                                    'patient'
                                );

                            if (cancelPatientRef) {

                                var cancelPatGr =
                                    new GlideRecord(
                                        PATIENT_TABLE
                                    );

                                if (
                                    cancelPatGr.get(
                                        cancelPatientRef
                                    )
                                ) {

                                    if (
                                        cancelPatGr.isValidField(
                                            'email'
                                        )
                                    ) {

                                        cancellationEmail =
                                            cancelPatGr.getValue(
                                                'email'
                                            ) || '';
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }


                        if (cancellationEmail) {

                            var cancelMailer =
                                new GlideEmailOutbound();

                            cancelMailer.setTo(
                                cancellationEmail
                            );

                            cancelMailer.setSubject(
                                'Appointment Cancelled: ' +
                                cancelGr.getValue(
                                    'appointment_number'
                                )
                            );

                            cancelMailer.setBody(

                                '<div style="font-family:Arial,sans-serif;max-width:600px;margin:auto;">' +

                                '<div style="background:#0a2463;padding:20px;color:white;border-radius:10px 10px 0 0;">' +

                                '<h2 style="margin:0;">MediCare Diagnostic Center</h2>' +

                                '</div>' +

                                '<div style="padding:24px;background:#fff1f2;border:2px solid #ef4444;">' +

                                '<h3 style="color:#b91c1c;">Appointment Cancelled</h3>' +

                                '<p>Your appointment <strong>' +

                                cancelGr.getValue(
                                    'appointment_number'
                                ) +

                                '</strong> has been cancelled.</p>' +

                                '<p>If this was a mistake, please book another appointment.</p>' +

                                '</div>' +

                                '</div>'
                            );

                            cancelMailer.save();
                        }

                    } catch (emailError) {

                        gs.warn(
                            'MediCare Cancellation Email Error: ' +
                            emailError.message
                        );
                    }

                } else {

                    data.error =
                        'You are not authorized to cancel this appointment.';
                }

            } else {

                data.error =
                    'Appointment not found.';
            }

        } catch (cancelError) {

            data.error =
                'Cancel error: ' +
                cancelError.message;

            gs.error(
                'MediCare Cancel Appointment Error: ' +
                cancelError.message
            );
        }
    }


    // ============================================================
    // NO APPOINTMENTS
    // ============================================================

    if (appointmentSysIds.length === 0) {

        data.appointments = [];

        gs.info(
            'MediCare: No appointments found for user ' +
            userID
        );

        return;
    }


    // ============================================================
    // FETCH APPOINTMENTS
    // ============================================================

    try {

        var finalGr =
            new GlideRecord(APPOINTMENT_TABLE);

        finalGr.addQuery(
            'sys_id',
            'IN',
            appointmentSysIds.join(',')
        );

        finalGr.orderByDesc(
            'sys_created_on'
        );

        finalGr.query();


        // ========================================================
        // BUILD APPOINTMENT DATA
        // ========================================================

        while (finalGr.next()) {


            // ----------------------------------------------------
            // TEST DETAILS
            // ----------------------------------------------------

            var testName = '';
            var testCategory = '';


            if (
                finalGr.isValidField(
                    'test'
                )
            ) {

                var testRef =
                    finalGr.getValue(
                        'test'
                    ) || '';


                if (testRef) {

                    try {

                        var testGr =
                            new GlideRecord(
                                DIAGNOSTIC_TEST_TABLE
                            );

                        if (
                            testGr.get(
                                testRef
                            )
                        ) {

                            if (
                                testGr.isValidField(
                                    'test_name'
                                )
                            ) {

                                testName =
                                    testGr.getValue(
                                        'test_name'
                                    ) || '';
                            }


                            if (
                                testGr.isValidField(
                                    'category'
                                )
                            ) {

                                testCategory =
                                    testGr.getDisplayValue(
                                        'category'
                                    ) ||
                                    testGr.getValue(
                                        'category'
                                    ) ||
                                    '';
                            }
                        }

                    } catch (testError) {

                        gs.warn(
                            'MediCare Test Lookup Error: ' +
                            testError.message
                        );
                    }
                }
            }


            // ----------------------------------------------------
            // REPORT EXISTS?
            // ----------------------------------------------------

            var hasReport = false;


            try {

                var reportGr =
                    new GlideRecord(
                        REPORT_TABLE
                    );

                if (
                    reportGr.isValidField(
                        'appointment'
                    )
                ) {

                    reportGr.addQuery(
                        'appointment',
                        finalGr.getUniqueValue()
                    );

                    reportGr.setLimit(1);

                    reportGr.query();

                    if (
                        reportGr.next()
                    ) {

                        hasReport = true;
                    }
                }

            } catch (reportError) {

                gs.warn(
                    'MediCare Report Check Error: ' +
                    reportError.message
                );
            }


            // ----------------------------------------------------
            // APPROVED BY
            // ----------------------------------------------------

            var approvedByName = '';


            if (
                finalGr.isValidField(
                    'approved_by'
                )
            ) {

                var approvedByRef =
                    finalGr.getValue(
                        'approved_by'
                    ) || '';


                if (approvedByRef) {

                    try {

                        var approverGr =
                            new GlideRecord(
                                'sys_user'
                            );

                        if (
                            approverGr.get(
                                approvedByRef
                            )
                        ) {

                            approvedByName =
                                approverGr.getDisplayValue(
                                    'name'
                                ) || '';
                        }

                    } catch (approverError) {

                        gs.warn(
                            'MediCare Approver Lookup Error: ' +
                            approverError.message
                        );
                    }
                }
            }


            // ----------------------------------------------------
            // SCHEDULED DATE
            // ----------------------------------------------------

            var scheduledRaw = '';
            var scheduledDisplay = '';


            if (
                finalGr.isValidField(
                    'scheduled_date'
                )
            ) {

                scheduledRaw =
                    finalGr.getValue(
                        'scheduled_date'
                    ) || '';
            }


            if (scheduledRaw) {

                try {

                    var gdt =
                        new GlideDateTime(
                            scheduledRaw
                        );

                    scheduledDisplay =
                        gdt
                        .getLocalDate()
                        .getValue();

                } catch (dateError) {

                    scheduledDisplay =
                        scheduledRaw.split(' ')[0] ||
                        scheduledRaw;
                }
            }


            // ----------------------------------------------------
            // CREATED DATE
            // ----------------------------------------------------

            var createdOn =
                finalGr.getDisplayValue(
                    'sys_created_on'
                ) || '';


            // ----------------------------------------------------
            // APPOINTMENT NUMBER
            // ----------------------------------------------------

            var appointmentNumber = '';


            if (
                finalGr.isValidField(
                    'appointment_number'
                )
            ) {

                appointmentNumber =
                    finalGr.getValue(
                        'appointment_number'
                    ) || '';
            }


            // ----------------------------------------------------
            // STATUS
            // ----------------------------------------------------

            var status = 'pending';


            if (
                finalGr.isValidField(
                    'status'
                )
            ) {

                status =
                    finalGr.getValue(
                        'status'
                    ) || 'pending';
            }


            // ----------------------------------------------------
            // APPROVAL STATUS
            // ----------------------------------------------------

            var approvalStatus = '';


            if (
                finalGr.isValidField(
                    'approval_status'
                )
            ) {

                approvalStatus =
                    finalGr.getValue(
                        'approval_status'
                    ) || '';
            }


            // ----------------------------------------------------
            // PAYMENT STATUS
            // ----------------------------------------------------

            var paymentStatus = '';


            if (
                finalGr.isValidField(
                    'payment_status'
                )
            ) {

                paymentStatus =
                    finalGr.getValue(
                        'payment_status'
                    ) || '';
            }


            // ----------------------------------------------------
            // SLOT TIME
            // ----------------------------------------------------

            var slotTime = '';


            if (
                finalGr.isValidField(
                    'slot_time'
                )
            ) {

                slotTime =
                    finalGr.getValue(
                        'slot_time'
                    ) || '';
            }


            // ----------------------------------------------------
            // TOTAL AMOUNT
            // ----------------------------------------------------

            var totalAmount = 0;


            if (
                finalGr.isValidField(
                    'total_amount'
                )
            ) {

                totalAmount =
                    parseFloat(
                        finalGr.getValue(
                            'total_amount'
                        )
                    ) || 0;
            }


            // ----------------------------------------------------
            // NOTES
            // ----------------------------------------------------

            var notes = '';


            if (
                finalGr.isValidField(
                    'notes'
                )
            ) {

                notes =
                    finalGr.getValue(
                        'notes'
                    ) || '';
            }


            // ----------------------------------------------------
            // REJECTION REASON
            // ----------------------------------------------------

            var rejectionReason = '';


            if (
                finalGr.isValidField(
                    'rejection_reason'
                )
            ) {

                rejectionReason =
                    finalGr.getValue(
                        'rejection_reason'
                    ) || '';
            }


            // ----------------------------------------------------
            // CONFIRMATION SENT
            // ----------------------------------------------------

            var confirmationSent = false;


            if (
                finalGr.isValidField(
                    'confirmation_sent'
                )
            ) {

                var confirmationValue =
                    finalGr.getValue(
                        'confirmation_sent'
                    );


                confirmationSent =
                    (
                        confirmationValue === '1' ||
                        confirmationValue === 'true' ||
                        confirmationValue === true
                    );
            }


            // ====================================================
            // ADD APPOINTMENT TO DATA
            // ====================================================

            data.appointments.push({

                sys_id:
                    finalGr.getUniqueValue(),

                appointment_number:
                    appointmentNumber,

                status:
                    status,

                approval_status:
                    approvalStatus,

                payment_status:
                    paymentStatus,

                scheduled_date:
                    scheduledRaw,

                scheduled_date_display:
                    scheduledDisplay,

                slot_time:
                    slotTime,

                total_amount:
                    totalAmount,

                notes:
                    notes,

                rejection_reason:
                    rejectionReason,

                confirmation_sent:
                    confirmationSent,

                test_name:
                    testName,

                test_category:
                    testCategory,

                approved_by_name:
                    approvedByName,

                has_report:
                    hasReport,

                created_on_display:
                    createdOn
            });
        }


        // ========================================================
        // FINAL LOG
        // ========================================================

        gs.info(
            '=============================================='
        );

        gs.info(
            'MediCare My Appointments Loaded'
        );

        gs.info(
            'User: ' + userName
        );

        gs.info(
            'Patient Records: ' +
            patientSysIds.length
        );

        gs.info(
            'Appointments: ' +
            data.appointments.length
        );

        gs.info(
            '=============================================='
        );


    } catch (e) {

        gs.error(
            'MediCare My Appointments Error: ' +
            e.message
        );

        data.error =
            'Failed to load appointments: ' +
            e.message;

        data.appointments = [];
    }

})();]]></script><servicenow>false</servicenow><sys_class_name>sp_widget</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 09:05:58</sys_created_on><sys_id>90e8275283c78310037ec170deaad3e6</sys_id><sys_mod_count>6</sys_mod_count><sys_name>My Appointments</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Medical Diagnosis Center" source="x_2056490_medica_0">05b9f29683038310037ec170deaad3f2</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Medical Diagnosis Center">05b9f29683038310037ec170deaad3f2</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_widget_90e8275283c78310037ec170deaad3e6</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-03 11:42:13</sys_updated_on><template><![CDATA[<div class="my-appts">
<!-- HEADER -->
  <div class="appts-header">
    <div class="header-left">
      <h1 class="header-title">]]>📋<![CDATA[ My Appointments</h1>
      <p class="header-sub">Track all your booked diagnostic tests in one place.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="header-right">
      <button class="btn-book-new" ng-click="c.bookNew()">
        <i class="fa fa-plus"></i> Book New Test
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- STATS BAR -->
  <div class="stats-bar">
    <div class="stat-card" ng-repeat="stat in c.stats">
      <span class="stat-icon">{{stat.icon}}</span>
      <div class="stat-info">
        <span class="stat-val">{{stat.count}}</span>
        <span class="stat-name">{{stat.label}}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- FILTER TABS -->
  <div class="filter-tabs">
    <button
      class="filter-tab"
      ng-repeat="tab in c.tabs"
      ng-class="{'active': c.activeTab === tab.key}"
      ng-click="c.setTab(tab.key)"
    >
      {{tab.label}}
      <span class="tab-count" ng-if="tab.count > 0">{{tab.count}}</span>
    </button>
  </div>

  <!-- SEARCH + SORT -->
  <div class="list-controls">
    <div class="search-mini-wrap">
      <i class="fa fa-search"></i>
      <input
        type="text"
        placeholder="Search appointments..."
        ng-model="c.searchQuery"
        ng-change="c.filterAppointments()"
        class="search-mini"
      />
    </div>
    <select ng-model="c.sortBy" ng-change="c.sortAppointments()" class="sort-mini">
      <option value="date_desc">Newest First</option>
      <option value="date_asc">Oldest First</option>
      <option value="status">By Status</option>
    </select>
  </div>

  <!-- LOADING -->
  <div class="loading-center" ng-if="c.loading">
    <div class="spinner-ring"></div>
    <p>Loading your appointments...</p>
  </div>

  <!-- EMPTY STATE -->
  <div class="empty-appts" ng-if="!c.loading && c.filteredAppointments.length === 0">
    <div class="empty-emoji">]]>📭<![CDATA[</div>
    <h3>No appointments found</h3>
    <p ng-if="c.activeTab !== 'all'">No {{c.activeTab}} appointments yet.</p>
    <p ng-if="c.activeTab === 'all'">You haven't booked any tests yet.</p>
    <button class="btn-book-first" ng-click="c.bookNew()">Book Your First Test</button>
  </div>

  <!-- APPOINTMENTS LIST -->
  <div class="appts-list" ng-if="!c.loading && c.filteredAppointments.length > 0">
    <div
      class="appt-card"
      ng-repeat="appt in c.filteredAppointments"
      ng-class="'appt-' + appt.status"
    >

      <!-- LEFT ACCENT BAR -->
      <div class="appt-accent-bar" ng-style="{'background': c.getStatusColor(appt.status)}"></div>

      <!-- CARD CONTENT -->
      <div class="appt-content">

        <!-- TOP ROW -->
        <div class="appt-top">
          <div class="appt-title-group">
            <span class="appt-icon">{{c.getCategoryIcon(appt.test_category)}}</span>
            <div>
              <h3 class="appt-test-name">{{appt.test_name}}</h3>
              <span class="appt-number">{{appt.appointment_number}}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="appt-status-wrap">
            <span
              class="status-pill"
              ng-style="{'background': c.getStatusBg(appt.status), 'color': c.getStatusColor(appt.status)}"
            >
              {{c.getStatusIcon(appt.status)}} {{c.getStatusLabel(appt.status)}}
            </span>
            <span
              class="approval-pill"
              ng-if="appt.approval_status"
              ng-class="'approval-' + appt.approval_status"
            >
              {{c.getApprovalLabel(appt.approval_status)}}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- META ROW -->
        <div class="appt-meta">
          <div class="meta-chip">
            <i class="fa fa-calendar"></i>
            <span>{{appt.scheduled_date_display}}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="meta-chip">
            <i class="fa fa-clock-o"></i>
            <span>{{appt.slot_time || 'N/A'}}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="meta-chip">
            <i class="fa fa-tag"></i>
            <span>{{appt.test_category || 'General'}}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="meta-chip" ng-if="appt.total_amount">
            <i class="fa fa-dollar"></i>
            <span>${{appt.total_amount | number:2}}</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- PAYMENT + APPROVAL STATUS -->
        <div class="appt-info-row">
          <div class="info-badge" ng-class="'pay-' + appt.payment_status">
            <i class="fa fa-credit-card"></i>
            Payment: <strong>{{c.getPaymentLabel(appt.payment_status)}}</strong>
          </div>
          <div class="info-badge approval-info" ng-if="appt.approved_by_name">
            <i class="fa fa-user-check"></i>
            Approved by: <strong>{{appt.approved_by_name}}</strong>
          </div>
          <div class="info-badge conf-badge" ng-if="appt.confirmation_sent">
            <i class="fa fa-envelope-o"></i> Confirmation Sent
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- NOTES -->
        <div class="appt-notes" ng-if="appt.notes">
          <i class="fa fa-sticky-note-o"></i> <em>{{appt.notes}}</em>
        </div>

        <!-- REJECTION REASON -->
        <div class="rejection-banner" ng-if="appt.rejection_reason">
          <i class="fa fa-exclamation-circle"></i>
          <div>
            <strong>Rejection Reason:</strong>
            <span>{{appt.rejection_reason}}</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- ACTIONS -->
        <div class="appt-actions">
          <button
            class="appt-action-btn btn-view"
            ng-click="c.viewDetails(appt)"
          >
            <i class="fa fa-eye"></i> View Details
          </button>
          <button
            class="appt-action-btn btn-cancel"
            ng-if="c.canCancel(appt)"
            ng-click="c.cancelAppointment(appt)"
          >
            <i class="fa fa-times"></i> Cancel
          </button>
          <button
            class="appt-action-btn btn-report"
            ng-if="appt.has_report"
            ng-click="c.viewReport(appt)"
          >
            <i class="fa fa-file-text"></i> View Report
          </button>
          <span class="date-chip">
            Booked: {{appt.created_on_display}}
          </span>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- DETAIL MODAL -->
  <div class="modal-overlay" ng-if="c.showModal" ng-click="c.closeModal()">
    <div class="modal-box" ng-click="$event.stopPropagation()">
      <div class="modal-header">
        <h3>Appointment Details</h3>
        <button class="modal-close" ng-click="c.closeModal()">✕</button>
      </div>
      <div class="modal-body" ng-if="c.selectedAppt">
        <div class="detail-grid">
          <div class="detail-item">
            <span class="detail-key">Appointment #</span>
            <span class="detail-val mono">{{c.selectedAppt.appointment_number}}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="detail-item">
            <span class="detail-key">Status</span>
            <span class="detail-val">
              <span class="status-pill" ng-style="{'background': c.getStatusBg(c.selectedAppt.status), 'color': c.getStatusColor(c.selectedAppt.status)}">
                {{c.getStatusLabel(c.selectedAppt.status)}}
              </span>
            </span>
          </div>
          <div class="detail-item">
            <span class="detail-key">Test</span>
            <span class="detail-val">{{c.selectedAppt.test_name}}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="detail-item">
            <span class="detail-key">Category</span>
            <span class="detail-val">{{c.selectedAppt.test_category}}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="detail-item">
            <span class="detail-key">Scheduled Date</span>
            <span class="detail-val">{{c.selectedAppt.scheduled_date_display}}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="detail-item">
            <span class="detail-key">Time Slot</span>
            <span class="detail-val">{{c.selectedAppt.slot_time}}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="detail-item">
            <span class="detail-key">Total Amount</span>
            <span class="detail-val paid-green">${{c.selectedAppt.total_amount | number:2}}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="detail-item">
            <span class="detail-key">Payment Status</span>
            <span class="detail-val">{{c.getPaymentLabel(c.selectedAppt.payment_status)}}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="detail-item">
            <span class="detail-key">Approval Status</span>
            <span class="detail-val">{{c.getApprovalLabel(c.selectedAppt.approval_status)}}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="detail-item full">
            <span class="detail-key">Notes</span>
            <span class="detail-val">{{c.selectedAppt.notes || 'None'}}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="modal-footer">
        <button class="btn-close-modal" ng-click="c.closeModal()">Close</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>]]></template></sp_widget></record_update>
